title: Typography / Product Sans Lockups
slide_intent: Give a product name a compatible but distinguishable voice so readers can understand its relationship to the parent brand.
strategic_value: Product Sans can connect Google product names without making them visually compete with the logo.
demonstration: A typing sequence sets Google Maps, highlights the product-name letterforms and cycles through product labels before introducing Google Product Sans.
practical_value: Compare parent-logo character with product-name character in the same line before choosing a companion typeface.

content_islands.name: Parent and product lockup
content_islands.spec: Center the Google wordmark and product name on one baseline.

content_islands.name: Letterform inspection
content_islands.spec: Highlight individual name letters and cycle the product wording while retaining the parent mark.

reference_purposes.Intent: The article says Product Sans maintains distinction between the Google logotype and product name while complementing the identity.
reference_purposes.Expression: Changing product names demonstrate the companion typeface’s geometric character.
reference_purposes.Application: The animation shows the typeface in product lockups.

ingredient.name: Product Sans companion type
ingredient.role: Identify a product while maintaining a clear relationship with the Google wordmark.
ingredient.application: Pair the product name in Product Sans with the distinct Google logotype in the demonstrated lockup.
ingredient.scope: 2015 product branding and supporting identity materials, not a rule for all interface body text.
